SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you make your composition interesting to read? 2. Why is it important to proofread your composition?
